validation_notes: The right side of the chart (late June through late July) shows price consolidating in a tight, roughly flat range between ~0.0044 and ~0.0050 with no clear directional convergence - both upper and lower bounds are essentially horizontal, forming a rectangle/range rather than a descending triangle. A descending triangle requires a clearly falling upper resistance line with a flat lower support; here the highs are not making a consistent lower-high sequence, they're oscillating sideways. This looks more like consolidation/basing after a steep prior downtrend (Apr-Jun sell-off) rather than a triangle with defined converging trendlines. Volume is also declining but that alone doesn't confirm a triangle without clear trendline structure.
